Start date: 1017-05-12.  
Subtract 31 weeks = 31 × 7 = 217 days.  
Plus 2 days → total subtract 219 days.  

1017 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400, so not leap in Gregorian proleptic).  
Days in months before May 12 in 1017: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30 → total 120 days.  
May 12 is day 120 + 12 = 132nd day of year.  

Subtract 219 days from day 132:  
132 − 219 = −87 days.  
Go into previous year 1016 (leap year: divisible by 4 and by 400? 1016/4=254, 1016/400=2.54 → not divisible by 400, but Gregorian rule: years divisible by 4 but not by 100 are leap; 1016 not divisible by 100, so leap).  

Days in 1016 after −87:  
−87 means 87 days before Jan 1, 1017 = Dec 31, 1016 is day 366 (leap year).  
366 − 87 = 279th day of 1016.  

Month calculation for day 279 in leap year:  
Jan 31 (31), Feb 29 (60), Mar 31 (91), Apr 30 (121), May 31 (152), Jun 30 (182), Jul 31 (213), Aug 31 (244), Sep 30 (274), Oct 31 (305).  
Day 279 is 279 − 274 = 5 days into October → Oct 5.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1016-10-05
